verdict.rationale: Lowenstein Sandler is a law firm offering legal services such as venture, IP, employment and privacy work. An official CLI is a software-product axis that does not fairly apply to a professional-services firm. The evidence shows no first-party CLI; its llms.txt file and the Clerky partnership do not make it a CLI-shipping product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
